theorem greater_angle_subtends_greater_side (a b c : Point) (AB BC AC : Line) (h : formTriangle a b c AB BC AC) (h1 : (∠ b : a : c : ℝ) > (∠ b : c : a : ℝ)) : (|(a─b)| > |(a─c)|) := by
  -- Use the Law of Sines to relate the sides and angles of the triangle.
  have h2 : ∠ b : a : c = ∠ b : c : a := by
    -- Prove that the angles at points a and c are equal.
    apply Eq.symm
    apply Eq.symm
    apply triangle_angles_equal h
  -- Use the Law of Sines to show that the side opposite the greater angle is longer.
  have h3 : |(a─b)| / Real.sin (∠ b : c : a) = |(a─c)| / Real.sin (∠ b : a : c) := by
    rw [h2]
    exact triangle_sine_law h
  -- Use the fact that the sine of a greater angle is greater to conclude the proof.
  nlinarith [Real.sin_le_one (∠ b : c : a), Real.sin_le_one (∠ b : a : c), h1]
